description: This file provides a JavaScript module for interacting with the GNews API, including functions to fetch top headlines, search articles, and fetch by category. It normalizes the articles to a common shape and handles API requests with configurable environment variables.

methods.name: buildQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Constructs URL query parameters from given params object, always including the API key.

methods.name: doFetch(path, params = {})
methods.description: Performs fetch request to the API endpoint with query parameters, handles errors, and returns JSON data.

methods.name: normalizeArticle(a)
methods.description: Normalizes a GNews article object to the application's data shape.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines({ category, page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches top headlines with optional category, language, page, and pageSize parameters.

methods.name: searchEverything({ q, language = 'en', page = 1, pageSize = 20 } = {})
methods.description: Performs a keyword-based search across articles.

methods.name: fetchCategory(category, { page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches headlines for a specific category.

ctags.name: fetchCategory
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchCategory(category, { page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } = {})/

ctags.name: fetchTopHeadlines
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchTopHeadlines({ category, page = 1, pageSize = 20, language = 'en' } =/
